summary.headline: Astrology: Fallibility and Impiety
summary.text: A defense of astrology distinguishes its difficult and fallible calculations from impious invocations and incantations, citing Basil’s Hexaemeron and a Jewish prediction of a high priest’s death that was altered by a saint’s miracle and baptism. The argument concludes by warning against falsely labeling non-heretics heretics and condemning the saints’ teaching purpose.
